## Calculate in R

First, we use R to calculate the average life expectancy for each continent in 2002.

```{r}
#| label: calculate-life-exp

library(gapminder)
library(dplyr)
library(reticulate)

life_exp_2002 <- gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2002) |>
  group_by(continent) |>
  summarise(
    mean_life_exp = mean(lifeExp),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

life_exp_2002
```

## Use the R result in Python

Next, Python reads the object created by R and uses it to create a bar chart.

```{python}
#| label: fig-r-to-python
#| fig-cap: "Average life expectancy by continent in 2002, calculated in R and plotted in Python."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

life_exp_python = r.life_exp_2002

plt.bar(
    life_exp_python["continent"],
    life_exp_python["mean_life_exp"]
)

plt.xlabel("Continent")
plt.ylabel("Average life expectancy")
plt.show()
```
